# smerisk

> smerisk is an open-source Python library for probabilistic management control in SMEs: payroll at risk, cash-flow at risk (CFaR), credibility-weighted rates, fixed-price project risk, receivables risk and Benford audits. Install with `pip install smerisk`. Apache 2.0, alpha.

## Overview

- [Home](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/)

## Use cases

- [Payroll at risk](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/payroll_at_risk/)
- [Cash-flow at risk (CFaR)](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/cash_at_risk/)
- [Credible absenteeism and turnover rates](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/rate_credibility/)
- [Receivables risk and expected loss](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/receivables_risk/)
- [Employee attrition](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/attrition/)
- [Benford audit of FEC entries](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/ledger_audit/)
- [Fixed-price project risk](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/fixed_price_risk/)
- [Consulting team utilization](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/utilization_forecast/)
- [Perishable goods orders](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/fresh_orders/)
- [Counter staffing (Erlang C)](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/counter_staffing/)
- [Forecast reliability](https://oussamaelguerraoui.github.io/smerisk/usecases/forecast_reliability/)
